# Flexhub
> Wi‑Fi hotspot remote that turns a phone or tablet into a mouse, keyboard and drawing pad — no App Store install for everyday use.

Flexhub (formerly may have been called SmartHub) is a small USB/Bluetooth HID plug Everyday control happens in the browser after you join the device Wi-Fi hotspot.

## Key facts
- Product name: Flexhub (alternate: SmartHub)
- Product: Flexhub (storefront visualbuild.shop)
- Shop: https://visualbuild.shop/
- Wi-Fi hotspot SSID: flexhub
- Wi-Fi hotspot password: build.me
- Hotspot page: http://flexhub.local/ or http://192.168.4.1/
- Bluetooth device name: flexhub
- Everyday use: no App Store / Play Store app required
- Modes: USB HID into the target, or Bluetooth HID while powered from a charger
- Primary jobs: mouse, on-screen keyboard, drawing pad; spare TV-style remote is a bonus only
- USB mode can also work with DualSense-style and classic Bluetooth pads
- Not a networked KVM; not sold as a full DualSense replacement
- No ASB Agent / MCP / AI automation claims on this product page

## Quotable one-liners
- "Join the flexhub Wi‑Fi, open the browser, and your phone becomes a mouse, keyboard and drawing pad — no app for everyday use."
- "Flexhub is a Wi‑Fi hotspot remote for old phones and tablets that cannot (or should not) install another store app."
- "Plug in over USB, or power it and pair flexhub over Bluetooth on the device you want to control."

## Compared gently (no overclaims)
- vs phone-only remotes / KeyMod-style gadgets: Flexhub emphasizes browser control over its Wi-Fi hotspot plus USB or Bluetooth HID to the target, with mouse + keyboard + drawing pad as the headline.
- vs DexoPad-style pads: Flexhub is a tiny plug + your existing phone/tablet screen, not a dedicated hardware pad.
- vs NanoKVM-Go-style networked KVMs: Flexhub is a local Wi-Fi hotspot + HID, not remote desktop over the internet.
